title: Finite coefficient open pullback preserves K-injectivity
statement: For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$, a finite ring $A$, and a K-injective cochain complex $I$ of left modules over the continuous-function coefficient sheaf on $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the actual transported pullback $j^*I$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact] is K-injective. Here K-injectivity is null-homotopy of maps from acyclic complexes [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived].

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-finite-coefficient-open-restriction] and use its ring isomorphism to form the pushforward equivalence from the slice site, whose continuity is given by [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Construct its inverse coefficient map using the unit isomorphism and the inverse ring comparison; naturality and the two inverse identities verify the ringed-site equivalence equations. Build the natural module isomorphism from the stated additive section equivalences, semilinearity, and both naturalities. Apply [lem-pur-kinjective-restrict-localized] on the slice and transport K-injectivity along the additive equivalence and the resulting isomorphism of complexes. This proof is complete in Lean.

proof_origin: Lean proof by K5: slice restriction followed by the explicit ringed-site equivalence and sectionwise natural module comparison.

from.place: Proof: exact open restriction makes j^*I K-injective and computes Rj_*j^*K.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientOpenPullback_isKInjective {U T : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (A : Type (u + 1))
    [Ring A] [Finite A] [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (I : CochainComplex (FiniteCoefficientModules T A) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      (((finiteCoefficientModulePullback j A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)
